title: 第五章 诡异黑石鱼骨功第六章 入水化龙
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
那两人似乎对盒子里的东西讳莫如深，其中一人放好后，似乎觉得不妥，又折返回去，将盒子往离岸更远的草丛深处推了推。
“这下应该没事了吧？”
“行了，别自己吓自己。等过段时间把事办完，咱就不用在这岸边受罪，能回城里喝花酒了。”
“也是。不过曹哥还交代了个活，得顺手料理了。”
“几条杂鱼罢了，费不了什么手脚，回去前办了就行。”
两人的声音渐行渐远，直到彻底消失在河岸线的尽头，苏羽才敢游了出来。
“嘶……真冷啊！”
苏羽爬上岸，浑身瑟瑟发抖。他这具身体底子太薄，在冰水里泡了这么久，骨头缝里都透着寒气。
不过好在不算全无收获，游泳技艺涨了！
【技艺】：游泳（熟练1200）
这个季节下水，虽然难熬，但效果也是立竿见影。若是有足够的气血支撑，熟练度还能涨得更快。
“还是得尽快攒钱学武！”
拧干了湿漉漉的衣衫，苏羽犹豫片刻，还是忍不住走向了那处草丛。
那两人鬼鬼祟祟藏起来的，究竟是什么？
他在草丛中摸索了一阵，触手冰凉，正是那个漆黑的木盒。
苏羽深吸一口气，屏住呼吸，小心翼翼地掀开一条缝。
盒子里，静静躺着一块拳头大小的黑色石头，散发着一股子阴冷气息。
这石头极为古怪，表面布满了密密麻麻的孔洞，像是一块被虫蛀过的蜂窝煤。虽然没有任何光泽，但盯着那些孔洞看久了，竟让人有一种灵魂都要被吸进去的眩晕感。
“不入水就没事……”
苏羽回想起那两人的对话，心中一凛。这东西透着股邪性，绝非好东西。

他强压下进一步探究的冲动，迅速合上盖子，将草丛恢复原状，并清理掉自己留下的痕迹。
至于将这东西拿走，或者扔水里试试，他没有丝毫想法。
在这种未知且危险的东西面前，现在的他太弱小，任何多余的探究都可能是在找死。
……
下午，苏羽再次满载而归。
心中估算了下，这三日总计渔获足有一百多斤。
这个成绩，稳了。
他先回家换了身干爽衣物，这才不紧不慢地赶往集市。
此时正是集市最热闹的时候，钱家收鱼点前人头攒动。苏羽一眼就看到了白顺。
秋风萧瑟，这家伙竟然只穿了一件无袖短打，古铜色的肌肉线条分明，上面还挂着未干的水珠。他显然刚从水里上来不久，却丝毫不见寒意。
“大概率开始学武了。”苏羽暗自心惊。这白顺的气血已经超过普通人不少了。
将渔获交上，又等到天色渐暗，钱家管事清了清嗓子，朗声道：
content_en:
The two people seemed to be secretive about the contents of the box. After putting it away, one of them seemed to feel something was wrong, so he went back and pushed the box deeper into the grass farther away from the shore.
"It should be okay now, right?"
"Okay, don't scare yourself. When things are done after a while, we don't have to suffer on the shore and can go back to the city to drink wine."
"That's right. But Brother Cao also gave me a job, so I have to take care of it."
"It's just a few miscellaneous fish. It doesn't take much effort. Just deal with it before going back."
The two people's voices gradually became distant, and it wasn't until they completely disappeared at the end of the river bank that Su Yu dared to swim out.
"Hiss...it's so cold!"
Su Yu climbed ashore, trembling all over. His body was too thin, and after being soaked in ice water for so long, there was cold air in the seams between his bones.
But fortunately, it’s not all a gain, my swimming skills have improved!
[Skill]: Swimming (Proficiency 1200)
Although it is difficult to get into the water during this season, the effect is immediate. If there is enough energy and blood to support it, the proficiency will increase even faster.
"You still have to save money as soon as possible to learn martial arts!"
After wringing out his wet clothes, Su Yu hesitated for a moment and couldn't help but walk towards the grass.
What was it that those two people were hiding secretly?
He groped in the grass for a while, and his cold tentacles turned out to be the dark wooden box.
Su Yu took a deep breath, held his breath, and carefully opened a crack.
In the box, a black stone the size of a fist lay quietly, exuding a cold aura.
This stone is extremely strange. Its surface is covered with dense holes, like a moth-eaten briquette. Although there is no luster, staring at those holes for a long time makes people feel dizzy as if their souls are being sucked in.
"It'll be fine if you don't get into the water..."
Su Yu recalled the conversation between the two people and felt a chill in his heart. This thing has an evil nature and is definitely not a good thing.
He suppressed the urge to explore further, quickly closed the lid, restored the grass to its original state, and cleaned up the traces he had left.
As for taking this thing away or throwing it into the water and trying it, he didn't have the slightest idea.
In the face of this unknown and dangerous thing, he is too weak now, and any unnecessary exploration may be seeking death.
…
In the afternoon, Su Yu returned home with a full load again.
I calculated in my mind that the total catch in these three days was more than 100 kilograms.
This result is stable.
He went home first, changed into dry clothes, and then rushed to the market unhurriedly.
This is the busiest time of the market, and there are crowds of people in front of Qian's fish collection point. Su Yu saw Bai Shun at a glance.
The autumn wind was bleak, and this guy was only wearing a sleeveless shorts. His bronze muscles were clearly defined, and there were still wet drops of water hanging on them. He had obviously just come out of the water, but he didn't feel cold at all.
"There is a high probability that he will start learning martial arts." Su Yu was secretly shocked. Bai Shun's energy and blood are already much higher than those of ordinary people.
After handing over the catch and waiting until it got dark, the steward of the Qian family cleared his throat and said loudly:
